scope: Three verified celestial forms for Conjure Celestial, not every celestial in D&D
limitations: Authored Russian summaries, not official translation or full bestiary.
Innate spells and legendary actions remain text; spell lists link to SRD cards.
Conjure Celestial selects a celestial up to CR 4, or CR 5 only with a ninth-level slot.
GM supplies statistics and resolves summons; no automatic spell use, transformation or legendary action tracking.
